title: Practicing Chants
content:
Aware are you? you are telling a person have you acknowledge me, lets practice this when someone is absent say ,aware are you, any response is good and should be positive.

Hi I greet my friends lets start this exercise to chant our word and reuse words is the best way to make yourself authentic and in this practice you may gain Aura if you know what that means.

So lets chant ,breath in breath out cycles first lets breath in through our nose then breath out through our mouth do this three times then lets chant our words. first chant, making it happen! voice this out loud three times ok you got the hang of it.

Lets continue our work when you breath in through your nose say,making it happen, through your mouth and when you do this thats one cycle, so for your next task repeat this four times.
